changes.detail: Добавить read-only dom_describe({}); output описывает только launch identity, binding, grant, policy, schema, типы и полный envelope/item JSON Schema + валидный пример каждого типа. submit/admit принимают delivery_receipt отдельным аргументом.

options.migration: Additive DTO version negotiation; immutable receipt/instance tables and schema version. Existing candidates not rewritten. Legacy launches without verified delivery get BASELINE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED, trusted issuer reissues; no guessed backfill. Do not rewrite existing idempotency records or change L1+L2.
options.leakage: Auth from trusted launcher BEFORE descriptor. No work/branch lookup parameters. grant names are authorization facts, not discovered DB branch inventory; no hidden counts/revisions. Full schema contains types, not hidden instances. Generic SCOPE_DENIED help identical for missing/foreign. L1 only once at issuance, L2 unchanged, no L3.
options.decisions: O1/O2/O3, NU-AU006-01, L1+L2 retained; UD-02 unresolved. Does not itself close F-01/E3.
options.other_h: H1/H2/H3 addressed; H8 schema guessing reduced but agent still builds bytes/base64/key/deps. H7 provider interface needed from AN011; H6/H9 not solved.

cost.risk: Medium: receipt lifecycle/migration and public DTO surface; still manual byte assembly.
cost.cold_steps_removed: At least code lookup work/policy and missing-schema guessing removed; no measured full B trial.

options.name: B + dom_draft_claim: recommended scoped byte assembler

changes.detail: B plus dom_draft_claim(branch, claim{text,content_type,metadata,reason,origin_version,requirement_refs,basis[]}); no authority or work overrides. Strict unknown-field/type validation.

Server obtains work/task/policy/schema from verified launch; checks branch and every explicit basis in grant BEFORE lookup; pins only explicit basis current revisions; encodes exact UTF-8 text, validates item and metadata, canonicalizes dom-c14n/v1; derives stable key from normalized identity + current scope; returns package, digest, unsigned authorship and next_action. Never auto-fills semantic evidence or auto-submits.

Retain original gates; E2 additive receipt check at submit/admit; digest, independence, expected revision and stale dependencies still validated by existing engine. Do not add receipt into closed dom/v1 payload; keep transport argument to avoid accidental unknown field.
B plus closed DraftResponse/DraftAuthorship/Baseline/ErrorHelp. The production implementation MUST reject unknown structural fields, not serialize arbitrary facade dictionaries.
Same immutable instance/receipt migration as B; receipt verification not model-generated. Schema and templates versioned with validator, not copied fixture code.

options.migration: B plus additive tool registration. Canonical dom/v1 candidate stays unchanged; receipt is separately bound to delivery/transport then candidate at submit. Existing submit callers require reissued packet; old idempotency binding is preserved. Deterministic draft is not persisted; exact returned payload is the retry token. db_instance legacy assignment requires trusted initialization, never inferred from mere directory name.
options.leakage: All B guarantees plus branch/basis authorization before DB access; no automatic dependency enumeration, no inference of hidden links, no arbitrary external fetch. Refusals disclose no candidate/foreign branch/count. Exact bytes preserved; prompt-looking claim text remains inert data. Prototype functional equality tested; constant-time/network indistinguishability NOT established.
options.decisions: No accepted decision changes. O1 stale review still refuses, O2 public provenance unchanged, O3 delivery engine untouched, NU drafts remain possible during outage but no material admission. E1/E2 prototype only, E3 not tested. Receipt is delivery attestation, NOT author signature or independent approval.
options.other_h: H1/H2/H3/H8 addressed for supported fixture contract; AN011 must provide scoped dynamic requirement/branch definitions. Does not read candidate content for reviewer (AN010), fix stale remediation (AN012), enforce real independent identities (H10), or run sync (H11).

cost.risk: Medium-high: receipt lifecycle, instance migration, schema drift, ensuring helper never becomes admission bypass.

recommendation.reason: Server supplies the contract AND byte-correct candidate without changing admission; B is cheaper but still delegates canonical bytes/hash assembly to novice agent.
